caseNameFull: National Surety Corp. v. Musgrove, doing business as Musgrove Insurance Agency
attorneys: James E. Clark for petitioner. Charles A. Poellnitz for Musgrove et al., and Francis H. Hare for Southwick, respondents.

opinions.text: Motion of respondent, Gladys Holmes Southwick, for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.
